Three [[Blizzard Bomb]]s, {{Gem|212}}, {{Exp|680}} & {{TimeScaleTicket|5}} ([[All Paths]]) }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|All enemies have Slime.|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Oops! All slimes!''' is a [[Challenge Maps|challenge map]], which uses a modified version of the [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode as its mode. Triumphing this challenge rewards the player with {{Gem|200}}, {{Exp|600}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|4}} and three [[Blizzard Bomb]]s. While in-game the '''Oops! All slimes!''' challenge states it gives {{Gem|125}}, {{Exp|400}} and {{TimeScaleTicket|3}}, this is not the case due to the modifiers present on this challenge boosting rewards by 60%/70%. Like with other challenges, rewards can only be gotten once a week. ==Changes== The main change in this challenge is all enemies spawn with the [[Slime (Attribute)|Slime]] attribute. This modifier also has multiple other effects, as it affects cash, wave structure and replaces some enemies with ones from the [[Nuclear]] modifier. It also applies the [[HP Locked]] modifier, setting the base health to 100, applies the [[Mutation]] modifier, increasing enemy health by 8% every wave after their debut and [[Badlands (Modifier)|Badlands]], which only boosts rewards and plays a track at the start of waves 1, 10, 20, 30 and 40. All of these modifiers boost the rewards by 60% total. ===Enemies=== A few enemies are replaced by the [[Polluted Wasteland II]] modifier variants, albeit with reduced health: *[[Fallen]] is replaced by the [[Toxic]] - 100 health ({{Color|No|-400}}) *[[Tank]] is replaced by the [[Abomination]] - 6,000 health ({{Color|No|-14,000}}) *[[Fallen Hero]] is replaced by the [[Super Toxic]] - 5,000 health ({{Color|No|-35,000}}) *[[Fallen Guardian]] is replaced by the [[Nuclear Guardian]] - 14,000 health ({{Color|No|-111,000}}) *[[Fallen King]] is replaced by the [[Nuclear Monster]] - 750,000 health ({{Color|Yes|+125,000}}) **As it has [[Bloated]] by default, its health is 1,500,000. **Through its ''Nuclear Summon'' ability, it can make the [[Splitter]], [[Mutagenic Blight]] and [[Rusher]] appear in '''Oops! All slimes!''' *[[Mystery]] is replaced by the [[Breaker2]]. *[[Mystery Boss]] is replaced by the [[Breaker4]]. *[[Dark Necromancer]] is replaced by the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]]. *[[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]] is replaced by the [[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]]. *[[Abnormal]] - 6 health ({{Color|No|-2}}) *[[Quick]] - 4 health ({{Color|No|-6}}) *[[Heavy]] - 16 health ({{Color|No|-44}}) *[[Breaker2]] - 50 health ({{Color|No|-30}}) *[[Necromancer King]] - 14,000 health ({{Color|No|-61,000}}) *[[Cursed Skeleton]] - 500 ({{Color|No|-750}}) Enemies that do not have a set cash that they give on death will give {{Money|5}} on death instead. Any enemies that do not have their health altered in any way by the challenge or modifiers present on this map are affected by [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode's health scaling. ===Wave Structure=== '''Bolded ''' names indicate an enemy type's debut. ----

===Cash=== Starting cash in this challenge is increased by {{Money|900}}, making it {{Money|1,400}} ({{Money|1,500}} if in the Paradoxum Games group). Additionally, the wave bonus is also increased. The formula for calculating wave bonus on each wave is: :{{Money|200}} + ({{Money|100}} × Waves Completed - 1) Depending on player count, the wave bonus is reduced using multipliers, by same amount as in regular [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. These multipliers are: {| class="wikitable pad-10 align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Players !Reduction per Player !Total Reduction |- |Solo |0% |0% |- |Duo |15% |30% |- |Trio |13% |39% |} Prior to the 2nd of August 2024, cash was reduced by 10% for each player, starting with it being reduced by 10% in solo and going up to a 30% reduction in trio. ==Strategy== *For the first few waves, the number of [[Abnormal]]s that spawns is reduced significantly, allowing you to farm for the first few waves. **[[Slime]]s do not spawn as long as the enemy is not killed. **By Wave 5, the number of enemies is the same as regular [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. Defenses should be set up a few waves before it. **You may want to use the [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Cowboy]] over the [[Farm]] in this challenge as they can make money out of the [[Slime]]s that spawn. However, it is recommended to use both towers, as most enemies in this challenge do not have a set given cash, meaning they will give only {{Money|5}}. Additionally, the improved wave bonus allows you to farm better. *As [[Slime]] has 100 health, this means every enemy has 100 more health than usual, with the increase getting bigger with each wave as the [[Mutation]] modifier is applied on this map. **The [[Brawler]] is the most effective option against this, as its high damage and cheap cost allow it to kill [[Slime]]s quickly. ***It is also harder for it to get overwhelmed by hordes, as early-on enemies are spaced out more than they usually are. **Stalling towers like the [[Cryomancer]] can be effective at stalling the [[Slime]]s, giving your towers more time to kill them. *As the [[Nuclear Monster]] is the final boss of this challenge, high DPS towers are required to triumph this challenge. This includes towers like the [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Ranger]]. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can also be quite useful at boosting their stats. **Optionally, you may also use the [[Mercenary Base]] for its [[Damage Buff]]. **The [[Damage Flag]] and [[Cooldown Flag]] consumables can also be very useful at boosting their stats. **The [[Medic]] may prove to be especially useful to handle stun abilities that [[Nuclear Monster]] does. *You may use a [[Nuke]] to clear the hordes of enemies that appear on the final wave, making it so that your towers can focus on the [[Nuclear Monster]] instead of the multiple enemies that spawn alongside it. *As the slime attribute applied to every enemy overrides abilities that would be performed on death, multiple enemies are much weaker than usual. This includes enemies like the [[Abomination]] being unable to revive itself or the [[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]] not being able to boost the speed of enemies. ==Trivia== *The challenge name may be a reference to ''Oops!
